contract: Pure pattern step in the core/operator shape over PatternStep v1 neutral maps: one model_call action per request for an answer of a fixed set of two or more members or of a schema, bounded repair calls by workflow/output-repair, and one finish with status decided and the value both checks accepted, or failed with a named reason. No model call, clock, store or process.
limits: A model call that did not complete is never tried again; a refused repair call ends as call_not_completed.
No tools in a typed decision; no provider is called or tested; each test input is a literal neutral map.
No engine claim: a parent pattern that needs the value calls step/2 inside its own step and reads the finish request.
An answer that matches the schema is not a correct answer; a failed finish is not evidence of completion.

grounding.claim: Named groups outside_the_set, valid_after_one_repair, invalid_at_bound, refusal_or_empty, finish_length, validators_disagree, repair_calls_visible, single_member_set_refused, deterministic_replay and laws_and_example pass, with the two negative controls of workflow/output-repair. Finite scenarios, not a universal proof.
Pinned Elixir immutable maps and term equality; the ready Contracts of workflow/pattern-step and integration/ai-text and the ELZ-141 model-call boundary are reused unchanged.

The engine records each input before the step reads it and charges and checks each action; the model-call binding of the host gives the ai-text completed map as its JSON view without changing content, structured or finish; the id is Run-wide unique; each answer Port pair has one meaning; the base request leaves room within the ai-text bounds for one echoed output and one repair text.

telemetry.contract: Pure step emits no observations; the engine owns instrumentation.

config.contract: The answer set or schema and the repair bound are intrinsic spec operands; no ambient settings.

control.contract: No independent process; cancel and run_ended are pattern inputs, not operational commands.
